title: Principal Consultant - (Senior Manager) Finance Transformation
description: Principal Consultant – Finance Transformation Location: Edinburgh or Glasgow (Hybrid) |  Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent Empower finance leadership through strategic transformation The Role Capco is looking for Principal Consultants to join our growing Finance Transformation capability within the Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) practice. You'll play a key role in helping CFOs, Treasurers, and senior finance leaders maximise the value of their finance and treasury functions through operating model redesign, process transformation, and strategic technology delivery. Partner with CFOs, Treasurers, and C-suite stakeholders to implement finance strategies, strengthen controls, and optimise regulatory reporting, including ICAAP, ILAAP, and Recovery and Resolution Planning (RRP). Define business requirements and manage end-to-end project delivery across finance, treasury, and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring appropriate governance where AI-assisted tools are utilised. Design and implement stress testing frameworks across credit, market, and liquidity risk to support regulatory compliance and strategic decision-making, using AI-enabled analysis where appropriate. Collaborate with technology teams to embed digital, automation, and AI-enabled solutions into finance processes, architecture, and operating models to improve efficiency and business outcomes. What We're Looking For Experience delivering finance transformation programmes within financial services or management consulting. Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, regulatory change, and financial reporting. Experience with finance technology implementations, including ERP platforms, subledgers, automation, and optimisation solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using approved AI tools to enhance analysis, productivity, and decision-making while maintaining sound professional judgement. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence audiences from project teams through to CFOs and executive leadership. Bonus Points For Professional finance qualification such as ACA, ACCA, or CIMA. Familiarity with Basel, Solvency II, IFRS, SOX, PRA, or EBA regulatory requirements. Experience delivering finance transformation programmes involving RPA, cloud technologies, AI-enabled solutions, or Generative AI within finance functions. Strong business analysis or project management credentials such as Agile, PMI, or PRINCE2. Experience supporting business development, proposition development, leadership initiatives, or client growth. Why Join Capco Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions. Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture. Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured career development. Help shape the future of finance transformation through innovation, automation, and technology. Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across financial services and energy. Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders. title: ETF and 1940 Act Registered Funds Compliance Officer - Assistant Vice President
description: About the Role iCapital is looking to hire a Compliance Officer to support the relevant investment advisers serving the Exchange-Traded Funds (ETF), Alternative Investments Fund-of-Funds, and 1940 Act Registered Funds businesses. This individual will assist with the implementation and administration of compliance programs for the firm’s SEC-registered investment advisers, registered investment companies, NFA- and CFTC-registered commodity pools, and other compliance-related activities involving these products or entities.  Responsibilities Maintain working knowledge of regulations applicable to ETFs and 1940 Act Registered Funds and their investment advisers, including the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, and Rule 6c‑11. Support the administration of the funds’ compliance and governance framework.  Assist in monitoring compliance with fund governing documents. Monitor regulatory developments affecting ETFs, including derivatives, valuation, liquidity, and related rulemaking, and assist in assessing their impact.  Support ETF and Registered Funds initiatives by identifying regulatory risks, escalating issues, and helping develop practical solutions.  Review fund marketing materials for consistency with fund disclosures, governing documents, regulatory requirements, and internal policies, and coordinate approvals with relevant stakeholders.  Conduct post-trade compliance monitoring, portfolio guideline testing, and issue resolution.  Support trading oversight frameworks, including best execution governance and related compliance practices.  Perform compliance testing, reporting, and remediation tracking to support timely resolution of issues.   Assist with compliance reviews of third-party service providers, including administrators, custodians, legal counsel, and auditors. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree is required 6+ years of compliance experience in the financial services industry, including experience with exchange-traded funds, derivatives, alternative investments, and the applicable regulatory landscape  Experience supporting investment company, investment adviser, and NFA or CFTC compliance programs and requirements  Experience supporting regulatory examinations, investigations, or other interactions with the SEC, FINRA, or NFA  Experience evaluating risk and mapping risks and controls across business practices  Able to collaborate with and provide guidance to colleagues across functions and levels Able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment Detail-oriented, with the ability to assess and prioritize multiple projects  Benefits The base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $145,000. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us X: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/ iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Risk & Controls Manager - Fixed Term
description: Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. Job Title Risk & Controls Manager - Fixed Term Contract: Fixed-term role until September 2027 As Manager, Risk & Compliance , you will help strengthen and harmonise the risk and compliance environment by carrying out a gap analysis of existing controls and supporting the implementation of an enhanced Group model. This role will focus on building and embedding a risk and compliance framework aligned to regulatory requirements, monitoring and testing programmes, and consistent execution across the business. What you will do Complete a gap analysis of the existing controls, with a view to implementing an enhanced Group model Lead the build-out, harmonisation and embedding of risk and compliance frameworks aligned to regulatory requirements and monitoring and testing programmes Enhance the reporting suite to support monitoring, governance and escalation Work closely with first line teams to embed controls into processes, including customer care, merchant onboarding, system readiness and AMLA requirements Support training, documentation and consistent execution of the framework across the business Escalate matters to the Head of EMEA Risk and Compliance and other senior stakeholders where required What you will need to have Strong technical expertise in operational risk and control frameworks within payments and/or financial services Deep experience in RCSA, control design, process mapping, and governance, risk and compliance systems Familiarity with EU regulatory expectations, including safeguarding, AMLA, AML, outsourcing and DORA Ability to work hands-on in complex, multi-stream programmes with high interdependencies What would be great to have Experience supporting implementation of a Group-wide risk and control framework and/or harmonising local practices to enterprise standards Experience developing reporting, dashboards or management information for risk and control monitoring and escalation Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please: Apply using your legal name Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. Note to agencies: Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. Warning about fake job posts: Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

Temporary Manager – Python Developer, Risk Technology & AI Position Summary RSM IS seeking a hands-on Python Developer at the Manager level to support technology, AI, and automation initiatives within our Risk Consulting practice. This temporary role will focus on developing and scaling Python-based solutions that enhance credit review and other risk-related workflows. The ideal candidate brings strong Python development experience, exposure to AI and large language models (LLMs), and experience building solutions that process large volumes of structured and unstructured data. Experience working in financial services, risk, credit review, audit, or another regulated environment is highly preferred. Key Responsibilities Develop, enhance, and scale Python-based applications, scripts, and automation solutions supporting credit review and risk workflows. Build solutions capable of processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data . Develop and maintain document ingestion, extraction, and analysis pipelines across PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and other file formats . Enhance existing AI and automation solutions and expand their use across additional lending portfolios and business use cases. Integrate large language models (LLMs) using OpenAI APIs and related technologies to support workflow automation, document analysis, and data processing. Design solutions that produce structured, traceable, and auditable outputs appropriate for governance, reporting, and review. Partner with business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. Support broader AI, automation, analytics, and process transformation initiatives across the practice. Qualifications Strong hands-on Python development experience, including building applications, scripts, data-processing solutions, or automation workflows. Experience integrating OpenAI APIs or comparable LLM technologies into applications or workflows. Experience building and deploying scalable AI or automation solutions , preferably within a regulated environment. Ability to translate business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions. Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively with both technical and business teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing Alteryx workflows and ETL processes .
